sectionSubtitle: Inspirations and habits to guide your day

quotes.quote1: Your body is not failing; honor your own pace with calm and patience.
quotes.quote2: Daily fatigue is real. Honor your body's signals and allow yourself to rest without guilt.
quotes.quote3: Caring for your mind and taking mindful pauses is an active part of your self-care.
quotes.quote4: A day with more entries does not erase your progress. Breathe gently: one moment at a time.

guidelinesAccordion.subtitle: Tap to view recommended habits
guidelinesAccordion.hydrationDesc: Maintain good water and fluid intake throughout the day to support your body's natural balance.
guidelinesAccordion.foodDesc: Opt for balanced portions throughout the day, prioritizing light foods that bring comfort to your routine.
guidelinesAccordion.restDesc: Regular breaks and quality rest bring calm and support overall routine wellbeing.

psychoCard.title: Calm & Restful Moments
psychoCard.desc: Setting aside time to relax and care for your daily routine brings ease to your life.
